value.rationale: The sharp all-genus threshold d=4 for the sign of the intrinsic nondegenerate transverse Bergman curvature is a motivated quantitative characterization of the 2026 finite-dimensional counterexample construction. Rank alone, the canonical map, and standard nonnegative pullback metrics do not settle the sign; the explicit gamma coefficients and uniform proof supply a natural reusable kernel formula and a concrete benchmark without claiming to solve positive-definite Bergman curvature conjectures.
